items.name: Finish the main story
items.hint: The game's own 100% list only shows up after the credits, so finish the story first.

items.name: Gang operations: all 39
items.hint: Open from chapter 1 and the steadiest early source of loot. Take the valuables and the safe.

items.name: Bank jobs: all 22
items.hint: Best left until chapter 3: before then the cash is ruined by dye packs. A small bank counts once you take both the cash drawer and the safe.

items.name: Loan-store jobs: all 7
items.hint: Best left until chapter 3, like the small banks. They pay in marked bills.

items.name: Stick-ups: 50 of 91
items.hint: Shops can be held up from the start of the game, so this one builds up as you play.

items.name: Narcotics fenced: 100,000
items.hint: Loot is not money until a fence buys it. Fences pay different rates for different goods, so compare before you sell.

items.name: Jewelry fenced: 100,000
items.hint: Fences pay different rates for jewelry. Check more than one before you sell a big haul.

items.name: Marked bills fenced: 250,000
items.hint: Bank and loan-store cash is marked. No fence takes it until a chapter 3 story mission gives you a way to stop the dye packs.

items.name: Large bank vaults: all 8
items.hint: Opens late in chapter 4 through an optional mission. Reported: a vault only opens during an armored-truck delivery and brings a 4-star wanted level.

items.name: Collectible card sets: 15 of 18
items.hint: 18 sets, about 480 cards. Check wall phone boxes, toolboxes, shelves and bathrooms.

items.name: Meditation spots: 15 of 18
items.hint: 15 of 18 is enough here. The trophy needs all 18, and one spot is at a house in chapter 1 only: take the first shared meditation there.

items.name: Stunts: 300 of 397
items.hint: Four kinds: 130 jumps, 202 bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. Bridges are quickest: pass under once, the extra challenge is optional.

items.name: Base model vehicles scanned: 200 of 277
items.hint: Boats and aircraft count. Reported: special one-off vehicles do not.

items.name: Animals studied: 100 of 255
items.hint: Studying an animal through binoculars is enough; you do not have to hunt it. Dog and cat breeds count separately.

items.name: Large vault: by the airport
items.hint: Payout in guides: 100,000 to 150,000. Follow a security van without getting close; the vault opens briefly when the guard carries the case in. Expect 4 stars at once.

items.name: Large vault: downtown, the richer one
items.hint: Payout in guides: 135,000 to 205,000. Reported: a shutter entrance.

items.name: Large vault: downtown, the other
items.hint: Payout in guides: 100,000 to 150,000. Reported: a back-alley entrance.

items.name: Large vault: beach district, the richest
items.hint: Payout in guides: 135,000 to 205,000.

items.name: Large vaults: beach district, three more
items.hint: Payouts in guides: 75,000 to 140,000. Reported: one has a dock nearby for a boat escape.

items.name: Large vault: the eighth
items.hint: The lowest payout, 65,000 to 110,000 in guides. Reported: it is the northern branch.

items.name: Small banks in the city county: 9
items.hint: Take both the cash drawer and the safe for each to count. The map's robbery filter shows what is left.

items.name: Small banks in the other counties: 5
items.hint: Three in one county and one in each of two more. Low payouts, but all 22 bank jobs are needed for 100%.

items.name: Painted eggs on the tower
items.hint: Top of the tallest broadcast tower in the city. A long climb; throw an egg off for a scene.

items.name: The swamp ape
items.hint: Flyers seen at night start a side job. It is in the marshes; guides disagree on which one.

items.name: Lights in the sky
items.hint: A rural road east of the port town, by a motel, around 2 a.m., from chapter 2. Tied to a hidden trophy.

items.name: The dog on the water scooter
items.hint: Get stranded out at sea and a dog rides up. Follow it to a small island with cash.

items.name: The giant crab
items.hint: At a marsh outpost: restore power at the fuse box, read the journal, then look away. Guides disagree on which marsh.

items.name: The humming monument
items.hint: In the canyon country. Unsolved so far: the controller buzzes and it beeps in a pattern.

items.name: The boat with the wrong map
items.hint: Moored outside the first house. Look at its navigation screen.

items.name: After the lights
items.hint: Reported: once taken, a restricted site in the south follows, with a permanent stat boost. Guides disagree on the door code.
